summary.text: HESNES HOLDING AS is a private limited company registered in Tønsberg, founded 2002-12-18. HESNES HOLDING AS is an investment and holding company, including participation in other companies and enterprises, as well as consulting and management activities. Its main industry code is 46.810: wholesale of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels and related products. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 9 702 000 NOK and the annual result was 38 504 000 NOK; operating income was up from 21 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 99 587 000 NOK in 2024 to 38 504 000 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 647 524 000 NOK in 2024 to 464 225 000 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is hesnes.no. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (549300P28THQ4SD4SW20). Recent changes in the register: business address set to Nedre Langgate 32 on 2026-07-05; industry code set to 46.810 on 2025-12-23.
